sources.entry: Fava - Web frontend of Beancount, a text based double-entry accounting system. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Python

summary.one_liner: Fava is a web frontend for Beancount, the text-based double-entry bookkeeping system.
summary.what_it_does: Fava provides a browser-based interface on top of Beancount ledger files, focusing on features and usability. The README describes it as a web interface for double-entry bookkeeping built on Beancount. It is installed with pip and launched by pointing it at a Beancount ledger file, after which the web interface is served locally. An online demo and a website with a Getting Started guide are linked. The README also points to a Development page for running development versions and states that contributions are welcome. The README excerpt does not list specific reports or features beyond this.
use_cases: view and browse a Beancount ledger in a web browser
personal finance tracking with plain-text accounting
exploring accounts and transactions in a graphical interface
notable: Web frontend for the plain-text Beancount accounting system
Installable with pip and started with a single command on a ledger file
Focus on features and usability, per the README
caveats: Requires an existing Beancount ledger file; the README points to a Getting Started guide for learning Beancount
The README excerpt does not describe platform limits or hosting details
